title: Durood-e-Ibrahim
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.
english: O Allah, bestow Your favour on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You bestowed Your favour on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3370 — the standard durood recited in Salah

title: Durood Tanjeena
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُنْجِينَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْأَهْوَالِ وَالْآفَاتِ وَتَقْضِي لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيعَ الْحَاجَاتِ وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَتَرْفَعُنَا بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا أَقْصَى الْغَايَاتِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْخَيْرَاتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَمَاتِ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan tunjina biha min jami'il-ahwali wal-afat, wa taqdi lana biha jami'al-hajat, wa tutahhiruna biha min jami'is-sayyi'at, wa tarfa'una biha 'indaka a'lad-darajat, wa tuballighuna biha aqsal-ghayat min jami'il-khayrati fil-hayati wa ba'dal-mamat.
english: O Allah, send prayers upon our master Muhammad, a prayer by which You save us from all terrors and afflictions, fulfil for us all our needs, purify us from all sins, raise us to the highest ranks in Your sight, and bring us to the farthest goals of all good things in this life and after death.
reference: Traditional salawat, transmitted by Shaykh Musa al-Darir (al-Fajr al-Munir) — not a sahih hadith; a composed prayer of the righteous

title: Durood-e-Taj
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ وَالْمِعْرَاجِ وَالْبُرَاقِ وَالْعَلَمِ دَافِعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْوَبَاءِ وَالْقَحْطِ وَالْمَرَضِ وَالْأَلَمِ اِسْمُهُ مَكْتُوبٌ مَرْفُوعٌ مَشْفُوعٌ مَنْقُوشٌ فِي اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ سَيِّدِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ جِسْمُهُ مُقَدَّسٌ مُعَطَّرٌ مُطَهَّرٌ مُنَوَّرٌ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَالْحَرَمِ شَمْسِ الضُّحَى بَدْرِ الدُّجَى صَدْرِ الْعُلَى نُورِ الْهُدَى كَهْفِ الْوَرَى مِصْبَاحِ الظُّلَمِ جَمِيلِ الشِّيَمِ شَفِيعِ الْأُمَمِ صَاحِبِ الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ وَاللَّهُ عَاصِمُهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ خَادِمُهُ وَالْبُرَاقُ مَرْكَبُهُ وَالْمِعْرَاجُ سَفَرُهُ وَسِدْرَتُ الْمُنْتَهَى مَقَامُهُ وَقَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ مَطْلُوبُهُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ مَقْصُودُهُ وَالْمَقْصُودُ مَوْجُودُهُ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ خَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ شَفِيعِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ أَنِيسِ الْغَرِيبِينَ رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ رَاحَةِ الْعَاشِقِينَ مُرَادِ الْمُشْتَاقِينَ شَمْسِ الْعَارِفِينَ سِرَاجِ السَّالِكِينَ مِصْبَاحِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ مُحِبِّ الْفُقَرَاءِ وَالْغُرَبَاءِ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ سَيِّدِ الثَّقَلَيْنِ نَبِيِّ الْحَرَمَيْنِ إِمَامِ الْقِبْلَتَيْنِ وَسِيلَتِنَا فِي الدَّارَيْنِ صَاحِبِ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ مَحْبُوبِ رَبِّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَالْمَغْرِبَيْنِ جَدِّ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ مَوْلَانَا وَمَوْلَى الثَّقَلَيْنِ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ نُورٍ مِنْ نُورِ اللَّهِ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُشْتَاقُونَ بِنُورِ جَمَالِهِ صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin Sahibit-Taaji wal-Mi'raaji wal-Buraaqi wal-'Alam, Daafi'il-balaa'i wal-wabaa'i wal-qahti wal-maradi wal-alam. Ismuhu maktoobun marfoo'un mashfoo'un manqooshun fil-Lawhi wal-Qalam, Sayyidil-'Arabi wal-'Ajam. Jismuhu muqaddasun mu'attarun mutahharun munawwarun fil-Bayti wal-Haram, Shamsid-Duha Badrid-Duja Sadril-'Ula Nooril-Huda Kahfil-Wara Misbahiz-Zulam, Jameelish-Shiyami Shafee'il-Umam, Sahibil-Joodi wal-Karam. Wallahu 'aasimuhu wa Jibreelu khaadimuhu wal-Buraaqu markabuhu wal-Mi'raaju safaruhu wa Sidratul-Muntaha maqaamuhu wa Qaaba Qawsayni matloobuhu wal-matloobu maqsooduhu wal-maqsoodu mawjooduhu, Sayyidil-Mursaleena Khaatimin-Nabiyyeena Shafee'il-Mudhnibeena Aneesil-Ghareebeena Rahmatal-lil-'Aalameena Raahatil-'Aashiqeena Muraadil-Mushtaqeena Shamsil-'Aarifeena Siraajis-Saalikeena Misbaahil-Muqarabeena Muhibbil-Fuqaraa'i wal-Ghurabaa'i wal-Masaakeen, Sayyidith-Thaqalayni Nabiyyil-Haramayni Imaamil-Qiblatayni wa Seelatina fid-Daarayni Sahibi Qaaba Qawsayni Mahboobi Rabbil-Mashriqayni wal-Maghribayni Jaddil-Hasani wal-Husayni Mawlana wa Mawlath-Thaqalayni Abil-Qasimi Muhammadin ibni 'Abdillah, Noorin min Noorillah. Ya ayyuhal-Mushtaqoona bi-Noori Jamaalihi, sallu 'alayhi wa aalihi wa ashaabihi wa sallimu tasleema.
english: O Allah, send prayers upon our master and patron Muhammad, the bearer of the crown, the Ascension, the Buraq and the banner, the repeller of affliction, epidemics, drought, illness and pain. His name is inscribed, exalted, paired with Allah's name, and engraved upon the Preserved Tablet and the Pen. The master of the Arabs and the non-Arabs, whose body is sacred, perfumed, purified and illumined in the House and the Sanctuary — the sun of the forenoon, the full moon of the darkness, the foremost of the heights, the light of guidance, the refuge of creation, the lamp of darkness, the beautiful in character, the intercessor of the nations, the possessor of generosity and nobility. Allah is his Protector, Jibreel is his servant, the Buraq is his mount, the Ascension is his journey, the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary is his station, the distance of two bows' lengths is his goal, the sought is his aim, and the aim is attained by him. The master of the Messengers, the seal of the Prophets, the intercessor of sinners, the friend of strangers, a mercy to the worlds, the comfort of lovers, the desire of the yearning, the sun of the knowers, the lamp of travellers, the light of those drawn near, the lover of the poor, the strangers and the needy, the master of the two worlds, the Prophet of the two Sanctuaries, the Imam of the two Qiblas, our means in both abodes, the possessor of the two bows' lengths, the beloved of the Lord of the two easts and the two wests, the grandfather of Hasan and Husayn, our master and the master of the two worlds, Abu'l-Qasim Muhammad son of Abdullah, a light from the light of Allah. O you who long for the light of his beauty, send prayers upon him and his family and his Companions, and grant them peace abundantly.
reference: Traditional salawat, composed by Shaykh Abu Bakr bin Salim (d. 992 AH) — not a hadith; a composed prayer of the righteous

title: Durood-e-Shifa (Salat al-Tibbiyya)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ طِبِّ الْقُلُوبِ وَدَوَائِهَا وَعَافِيَةِ الْأَبْدَانِ وَشِفَائِهَا وَنُورِ الْأَبْصَارِ وَضِيَائِهَا وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin Tibbil-qulubi wa dawa'iha wa 'afiyatil-abdani wa shifa'iha wa nuril-absari wa diya'iha wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim.
english: O Allah, send prayers upon our master Muhammad, the medicine of hearts and their cure, the health of bodies and their healing, the light of eyes and their illumination, and upon his Family and his Companions, and grant them peace.
reference: Salat al-Tibbiyya, composed by Shaykh Ahmad al-Dardir (d. 1204 AH) — traditional salawat, not a hadith

title: Durood-e-Shafi'i
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ وَكُلَّمَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin kullama dhakarahudh-dhakirun wa kullama ghafala 'an dhikrihil-ghafilun.
english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad as often as those who remember You remember him, and as often as those who forget You forget him.
reference: Attributed to Imam al-Shafi'i — traditional salawat, not a hadith

title: Durood-e-Lakhi
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ كَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ كَرَمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ حُرُوفِ كَلَامِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ قَطَرَاتِ الْأَمْطَارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ أَوْرَاقِ الْأَشْجَارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ رَمْلِ الْقِفَارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ مَا خُلِقَ فِي الْبِحَارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ الْحُبُوبِ وَالثِّمَارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ أَنْفَاسِ الْخَلَائِقِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ نُجُومِ السَّمَاوَاتِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَأَنْبِيَائِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَجَمِيعِ الْخَلَائِقِ عَلَى سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَإِمَامِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَقَائِدِ الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِينَ وَشَفِيعِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرَضِينَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِينَ وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا دَائِمًا أَبَدًا كَثِيرًا كَثِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi rahmati Llāh. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi fadli Llāh. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi khalqi Llāh. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi 'ilmi Llāh. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi ma khuliqa fil-bihar. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi l-hububi wath-thimar. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi l-layli wan-nahar. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi ma azlama 'alayhi l-laylu wa-ashraqa 'alayhi n-nahar. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi man salla 'alayh. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi man lam yusalli 'alayh. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi anfasi l-khala'iq. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi nujumi s-samawat. Allahumma salli wa-sallim 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi kulli shay'in fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Salawatu Llāhi ta'ala wa-mala'ikatihi wa-anbiya'ihi wa-rusulihi wa-jami'i l-khala'iqi 'ala Sayyidi l-mursalina wa-imami l-muttaqina wa-qa'idi l-ghurri l-muhajjalina wa-shafi'i l-mudhnibina Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa-ashabihi wa-azwajihi wa-dhurriyyatihi wa-ahli baytihi wa-ahli ta'atika ajma'ina min ahli s-samawati wal-aradina bi-rahmatika ya Arhama r-rahimina wa-ya Akrama l-akramin. Wa-salla Llāhu ta'ala 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa-alihi wa-ashabihi ajma'ina wa-sallim tasliman da'iman abadan kathiran kathiran wa-l-hamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-'alamin.
english: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the vastness of the mercy of Allah. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the vastness of the favour of Allah. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of Allah's creation. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the vastness of the knowledge of Allah. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master and patron Muhammad, equal to the number of the words of Allah. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the vastness of the generosity of Allah. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the letters of the speech of Allah. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the raindrops. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the leaves on the trees. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the grains of sand in the deserts. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of everything created in the oceans. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the seeds and fruits. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of every night and every day. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of all that the night covers and the day shines upon. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of those who have sent prayers upon him. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of those who have not sent prayers upon him. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the breaths of all creation. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of the stars of the heavens. O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our master and patron Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, equal to the number of everything in this world and the Hereafter. May the prayers of Allah the Exalted, His Angels, His Prophets, His Messengers, and all creation be upon the master of the Messengers, the imam of the pious, the leader of those distinguished by the radiant marks of ablution, the intercessor of sinners, our master and patron Muhammad, and upon his Family, his Companions, his wives, his descendants, the people of his Household, and all those who obey You among the inhabitants of the heavens and the earths, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful, O Most Generous of the generous. May Allah the Exalted send prayers upon our master Muhammad, his Family and his Companions, all of them. And grant them peace, continually and eternally, in great, great abundance. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
reference: Traditional salawat, attributed to Sultan Mahmud Ghaznavi — the Thousand-Fold Salutation; not a hadith

title: Durood-e-Mahi (Darood Rahmat)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ خَيْرِ الْخَلَائِقِ وَأَفْضَلِ الْبَشَرِ وَشَفِيعِ الْأُمَمِ يَوْمَ الْحَشْرِ وَالنَّشْرِ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ مَعْلُومٍ لَكَ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ وَسَلِّمْ وَصَلِّ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ وَصَلِّ عَلَى كُلِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا كَثِيرًا بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَبِفَضْلِكَ وَبِكَرَمِكَ يَا أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِينَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ يَا قَدِيمُ يَا دَائِمُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا وِتْرُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, khayri l-khala'iqi wa-afdali l-bashari wa-shafi'i l-umami yawma l-hashri wan-nashri, wa-salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin bi-'adadi kulli ma'lumin laka, wa-salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin wa-barik wa-sallim, wa-salli 'ala jami'i l-anbiya'i wal-mursalina, wa-salli 'ala kulli l-mala'ikati l-muqarrabina wa 'ala 'ibadi Llāhi s-salihina, wa-sallim tasliman kathiran kathiran bi-rahmatika wa-bi-fadlika wa-bi-karamika, ya Akrama l-akramina, bi-rahmatika ya Arhama r-rahimina, ya Qadimu, ya Da'imu, ya Hayyu, ya Qayyumu, ya Witru, ya Ahadu, ya Samadu, ya man lam yalid wa-lam yulad wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun, bi-rahmatika ya Arhama r-rahimin.
english: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the Family of Muhammad, the best of creation, the most excellent of mankind, and the intercessor of the nations on the Day of Gathering and Resurrection. Send prayers upon our master Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad by the number of everything that is known to You. Send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the Family of Muhammad, bless them and grant them peace. Send prayers upon all the Prophets and Messengers, upon all the Angels brought near to You, and upon Allah's righteous slaves. Grant peace in great abundance through Your mercy, Your favour and Your generosity, O Most Generous of the generous. By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. O Eternal One. O Everlasting One. O Ever-Living One. O Self-Subsisting One. O Unique One. O One. O Eternally Self-Sufficient One. O You Who neither beget nor are begotten, and to Whom none is comparable. By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
reference: Traditional salawat, also known as Darood Rahmat (The Prayer of Mercy) — not a hadith

title: Durood (Sahih Muslim 405)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahima, fil-'alamin, innaka Hamidun Majid.
english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed the family of Ibrahim, and give barakah to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You gave barakah to Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. In all the worlds, You are worthy of praise and glorious.

title: Short Durood
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin.
english: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.

title: Durood-e-Roohi
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَرْوَاحِ وَعَلَى صُورَتِهِ فِي الصُّوَرِ وَعَلَى جِسْمِهِ فِي الْأَجْسَادِ وَعَلَى قَبْرِهِ فِي الْقُبُورِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik 'ala ruhi Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-arwahi wa 'ala surati fil-suwari wa 'ala jismihi fil-ajsadi wa 'ala qabri fil-quburi wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim.
english: O Allah, bestow blessings and peace and benedictions upon the soul of our master Muhammad among the souls, and upon his form among forms, and upon his body among bodies, and upon his grave among graves, and upon his family and companions, and grant them peace.
reference: Traditional salawat, Durood-e-Roohi (The Prayer of the Soul) — not a hadith
